name: Compiled flume pier scour equilibrium dataset
model_or_instrument: laboratory flume experiments with cylindrical piers in sediment beds
access: All data used are collected from the reported laboratory measurements in the literature reported elsewhere (Ali & Dey, 2024; Dey & Ali, 2024) and no new data are generated in this work.

scales.note: Compiled dataset of 484 equilibrium scour depth observations from 16 flume experimental studies reported as bulk dimensionless quantities and scalar values.
